title: QUIC RFC 9000 Packet Classification And Connection Association Verification
verification_method: Focused S5P2 and S5P2P1 requirement-home tests over endpoint packet classification, existing connection association, server Initial admission, client-selected non-zero and maximum-length connection-ID routing, zero-length local-endpoint matching, version mismatch discard, and weakly protected invalid packet discard, plus Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the bounded endpoint ingress floor for packet classification, packet association, and selected-version discard before the weak-protection rollback tail.
expected_result: The focused tests show incoming packets are classified on receipt, existing routes are preferred when they match, conforming Initial packets can create server connections, client-selected Destination Connection IDs route exactly in long and short headers, zero-length connection IDs route by the endpoint's local-address identity, packets with a different selected version are discarded, and invalid weakly protected packet forms are discardable without runtime packet-space processing.
procedure: Run the focused S5P2 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The server pre-acceptance ingress policy under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0055 remains the owner for unsupported-version Version Negotiation and listener admission before route creation.
The stateless-reset path remains separately owned by the S10/S9001 stateless reset artifacts.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim packet-protection removal failure handling, pre-error connection-error generation, rollback of weakly protected packet side effects, public API widening, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S5P2 association filter passed 20/20, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0001 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0006, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0008, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0009, and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0258 trace_clean and reports 1,283 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 460 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,515/4,515, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
